records.whyMatchesSeveral: “{words}” matches more than one entry in the cards
records.whyNotChoice: “{value}” is not one of the choices
records.unmatchedNone: {what} “{words}” matches nothing, so it was left out.
records.unmatchedSeveral: {what} “{words}” matches more than one entry, so it was left out.
records.payoffNotOpen: The payoff “{words}” is not an open plant, so it was left out.
records.revealAgain: A reveal that had already come to light was named again, so it was left out.
records.behaviorNone: The behavior “{words}” matches no behavior of the cast, so it was left out.
records.behaviorSeveral: The behavior “{words}” matches more than one behavior of the cast, so it was left out.
records.plantsFull: Two plants were already open, so what this chapter planted (“{planted}”) is not counted as a plant.
records.goalPending: The beat planned a change to the goal, but the chapter did not carry it out. It stays pending.
records.revealStillAvailable: The beat planned a reveal that the chapter did not make, so it is still available.
records.notInChapter: “{name}” moved, but was not in this chapter, so it was left out.
records.shiftTwice: “{name}” appeared twice in the shifts, so the second was left out.
records.knowledgeUnchanged: A reveal landed, but nobody's knowledge changed. Check the Knowledge list in Entanglements.
records.changeLeftOut: A proposed change to {field} was left out: {why}.
records.laterNoPlant: A later chapter paid off something this chapter planted, and the new version plants nothing.
records.laterStale: The {n} later chapter(s) were written from the old version. They stay as they are, and their beats are marked stale.
records.knowledgeTooMany: a chapter adds at most {max} new Knowledge entries
records.knowledgeOneFact: it must name either a World rule or a fact, not both and not neither
records.knowledgeHasEntry: that person already has an entry for it; its status changes through that entry

app.older: This project was saved by an older version of Pulpermill. Anything newer than that version is blank.
app.restored: Restored. It is not saved yet, so save it when you can.
app.unreadable: That file could not be read as a project.
app.notProject: That file is not a Pulpermill project.
app.isCard: That file is a card, not a whole project. Use Import card… to bring it in.
app.newer: That project was saved by a newer version of Pulpermill than this page, so it was not opened. Opening it here could lose parts of it.
app.damaged: That project is damaged: its {card} card holds something it should not, so it was not opened.
app.confirmNew: Start a new project? The one you are working on has unsaved changes, and they will be lost.
app.confirmOpen: Open this file? The project you are working on has unsaved changes, and they will be lost.
app.confirmRestore: Restore the earlier work? The project you are working on has unsaved changes, and they will be lost.
app.confirmThrowAway: Throw away the unsaved work from {when}? It cannot be brought back.
app.recoveryFound: Your last session ended with unsaved work: {what}, from {when}.
app.undone: Put back what those fields held before the fill.
app.filled: The model drafted: {fields}. They are marked “Model draft” until you edit them.
app.nothingNew: The model had nothing new to add to this card.
app.dropped: The project changed while the model was working, so its answer was thrown away.
app.confirmReplace: The model’s draft would replace your words in: {fields}. Go ahead? You can undo it afterwards.
app.unmatched: The model named {names}, but nothing in your cards matches, so those links were left empty.
app.noSource: Add a note for this card, or an example chapter, first. The model fills a card from one of them.
app.noInstance: That character isn’t there any more.
app.backendBad: That isn’t an address I can use. Type “mock”, or something like localhost:8000.
app.backendMixed: This page is served over https, so the browser won’t let it call a plain http address. Use an https address, or open the page from your own computer.
app.whereMock: the built-in sample model, which writes placeholder text (nothing leaves this page)
app.writtenBeat: This beat was written from. To change the chapter, write it again below.

app.lockedBanner: This card is locked because the story has started. You can read it, but not change it.
app.undoBlocked: Undo would throw away words you changed since the fill, so nothing was put back.

app.unlockCardHelp: You locked this card. Unlock it to change it again.

card.tagLiveHelp: What you write is the starting point. The model updates it as chapters are written, and you can edit it between chapters.
card.tagFixedHelp: The model always gets this exactly as written and never changes it during the story.
card.noteLive: Fields tagged “{tag}” are where things start. The model updates them chapter by chapter, and you can edit them between chapters.
card.noteFixed: Fields tagged “{tag}” go to the model exactly as written, and it never changes them during the story.
card.unsupported: This field type isn't built yet.
card.clean: Nothing wrong found on this page.
card.tagDraftHelp: The model wrote this. It stays marked until you edit it.
card.modelOne: The model flagged 1 thing worth a look.
card.modelMany: The model flagged {n} things worth a look.
card.modelUnanswered: {n} of its checks got no answer, so they were not counted as passed.
card.fillTitle: Fill this card with the model
card.fillHelp: Write a few rough notes, or paste a chapter you like. The model drafts the fields and you edit them. It fills empty fields, asks before replacing anything you wrote, and you can undo it.
card.notePlaceholder: Rough is fine: a few lines, or a pasted description.
card.examplePlaceholder: A chapter you wrote or like. The model learns the voice and the world from it.
card.fillSends: Pressing the button sends this card, the cards it reads, and your notes and example chapter to {where}.

errors.busy: The model is busy with another job, so nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
errors.bad_output: The model’s answer didn’t come out in the right shape, so nothing was changed. Press the button again.
errors.too_long: There is too much text to send to the model in one go, so nothing was changed. Shorten the notes or the example chapter.
errors.server: The model’s server had a problem, so nothing was changed.
errors.unreachable: Couldn’t reach the model, so nothing was changed. Check the address and that it is running.
errors.timeout: The model took too long to answer, so nothing was changed.
errors.bad_request: The page sent something the model’s server didn’t understand, so nothing was changed.
errors.unauthorized: The model’s server didn’t accept the access token, so nothing was changed. Check the token beside the address.

card.removeLastOnly: Beats are deleted from the last one backwards. Delete the later ones first.

story.intro: When your cards are ready, start the story. That locks Style, Characters, World and Setup, so they stay as you wrote them while chapters are written. Entanglements and each chapter’s plan stay editable.
story.checking: The model is checking that the protagonist suits the voice…
story.fixFirst: Fix these first. The story can’t start while a card has problems that stop generating.
story.noProtagonist: Setup needs a protagonist before the model can check the voice.
story.misfitBare: The model thinks the protagonist may not suit the voice you chose. Start the story anyway?
story.started: The story has started. Style, Characters, World and Setup are locked: you can read them, but not change them.
story.startedKept: The story has started. Style, Characters, World and Setup stay locked for the rest of the story, because chapters are written from them.
story.confirmUnlock: Unlock Style, Characters, World and Setup so you can edit them? You will need to start the story again.
story.unlocked: The cards are unlocked. Start the story again when you are ready.
story.begun: The story has started. Style, Characters, World and Setup are now locked.

plan.title: Plan the next chapter
plan.notStarted: Start the story first (the bar above). The plan is made from the cards as they will be locked.
plan.allDone: Every chapter is written. Use the end-of-story step when you are ready.
plan.noPressure: Entanglements has no pressure yet, so there is nothing to spotlight. Add one first.
plan.castHelp: The protagonist is always in, and up to {max} people can be. People in the next pressure are suggested first, then the people used least so far, so everyone gets time.
plan.goalNone: none: the goal has ended, so the story winds down
plan.goalNeeded: none: the last goal ended and the story goes on, so this chapter starts a new one
plan.offstageYes: due: the model first decides what the background groups and places do
plan.sends: Pressing the button sends the cast, the cards in play and the summaries of earlier chapters to {where}.
plan.planned: Chapter {n} is planned. The beat is below: edit anything you like.
plan.retried: The first try broke a rule, so the model tried again.
plan.stillBlocks: It still has {n} problem(s) that stop generating. They are marked on the beat.
plan.unmatched: The model named {names}, but nothing in your cards matches, so those links were left empty.
plan.dropped: The model gave something that is not a choice here ({fields}), so it was left empty.

goalWarn.needed: The last goal ended and the story goes on, but this plan does not start a new one.
goalWarn.repeats: The new goal is close to one the story already had.
goalWarn.aimRepeats: What the protagonist is after in this chapter is close to an earlier chapter's.
goalWarn.stale: The goal has stood for {n} chapters. You may want it to end or change.
goalWarn.early: The story's own goal is achieved with {n} chapters still to go.
goalWarn.unsettled: This is the last chapter, and the plan does not settle the story's goal.

plan.undone: Put the plan back as it was.
plan.confirmReplan: Plan this chapter again? The beat you have now will be replaced. You can undo it afterwards.
plan.stale: The Entanglements have changed since this was planned. Plan it again to use the new state, or write the beat on as it is.
plan.thought: How the model thought about this chapter
plan.thoughtKept: This is kept with your project, and replaced when you plan the chapter again.

Write chapter {n} again?

end.title: End of the story
end.notDone: Available once every chapter is written.
end.help: The model reads what happened and how people changed, and updates the characters and the world to match. The result is kept as a separate after-story copy. Your cards stay as they are.
end.button: Update the characters and world with the model
end.working: The model is updating the characters and the world…
end.sends: Pressing the button sends the characters, the world and the summaries of every chapter to {where}.
end.confirmAgain: Update them again? The after-story copy you have now will be replaced, along with any edits you made to it. You can undo it afterwards.
end.editHelp: The copy is yours to correct. Change anything you like; nothing here goes to the model. Your cards above are not touched, and pressing the button again replaces the copy, edits and all.
end.undone: Put the after-story copy back as it was.
end.kept: The model changed {what}. Those fixed fields were put back as they were.
end.dropped: The model gave something that did not fit ({fields}), so those fields kept their old value.
end.problems: The copy has {n} problem(s) that its card would stop generating on. It is a record of the story's end, so they are only noted.
end.stale: A chapter was written again after this copy was made, so it may be out of date. Update it again to refresh it, or keep it and edit it by hand. Your own edits are replaced if you update it.

reasons.not_done: Every chapter has to be written first.

end.undoBlocked: Undo would throw away edits you made to the after-story copy since, so nothing was put back.

export.title: Export
export.storyHelp: Every written chapter in one markdown file ({n} of {total} written).
export.storyHelpNoTotal: Every written chapter in one markdown file ({n} written).
export.storyNone: Nothing to export yet: no chapter is written.

export.projectHelp: Use Save at the top. The project file holds everything, and opening it brings the story back as it was.

welcome.title: Welcome to Pulpermill
welcome.intro: You write the story. The model drafts the parts you ask it for, and you decide what stays.
welcome.way: The way from a blank page to a finished story

cards.title: Fill in the cards
cards.detail: Style, Characters, World, Entanglements and Setup describe your story. Fill them in yourself, or write a note on a card and press Fill to have the model draft it. Start with whichever you know best.

start.title: Start the story
start.detail: When the cards have nothing that stops the story, press Start the story. That locks Style, Characters, World and Setup, so every chapter is written from the same foundations.

chapters.title: Plan and write each chapter
chapters.detail: On the Outline card the model plans a chapter, you change the plan as you like, and then the model writes it. Plans and rewrites can be undone.

end.title: End the story (optional)
end.detail: The model updates the characters and the world to show how the story changed them. The result is a separate copy you can edit. Your cards stay as they are.

download.title: Download your work
download.detail: At the bottom of the Outline card, Export gives you the story as a text file and your cards as files you can bring into another project.

knowItems: Nothing happens by itself. The model works only when you press a button, one job at a time, and Stop ends it.
What the model writes is shown to you and can be changed. Its drafts are marked until you edit them.
Save downloads your project as a file. That file is your story and your cards, so keep it somewhere safe. This page keeps only a short-term safety copy in this browser.
Until you give a model connection, the page uses a built-in sample model that writes placeholder text, so you can try everything first.
